title: The Constrained Origin of Canonical and Microcanonical Ensembles in Quantum Theory
summary: In quantum theory, equilibrium statistical mechanics is usually formulated through the canonical ensemble, whose privileged status is tied to the Euclidean continuation of time evolution. The microcanonical ensemble, by contrast, is commonly introduced as a separate spectral construction. In this work we show that this asymmetry is representational rather than structural.
